question: In the Union Budget 2020, how much insurance coverage did the Government of India propose to increase on bank fixed deposits and savings which previously was ₹1 lakh only?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹ 5 lakhs.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• This is the first time since **1993 **that the deposit insurance coverage has been raised.
 
• In May 1993, deposit insurance cover was increased to Rs 1 lakh from Rs 30,000.
 
• The Indian Union** Budget 2020-21** announced that the** Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC)** has been permitted to increase deposit insurance coverage to Rs.** 5 lakh per depositor from Rs. 1 lakh previously**.
